ErrorDetail.description: Stable error fields without echoed input, tokens, or transcript text.

Interval.description: A half-open interval on the lecture clock, measured in integer milliseconds.
Interval.title: Interval

confidence.description: Uncalibrated recovery heuristic, never an attention score or probability of missed content.
confidence.title: Confidence

MissedWindow.title: MissedWindow

Receipt.description: Batch result: accepted writes, exact retries, and current session revision.

SignalBatch.description: At most 100 derived signal events for the URL's authorized session.
SignalBatch.title: SignalBatch

SignalEvent.description: A possible missed-content signal, never a measurement of attention.

confidence.description: Confidence in the observation, not attention or comprehension.
confidence.title: Confidence

source.description: Optional local producer label; conveys no identity or authorization. phone_visible only means a phone appeared in the camera frame.
source.title: Source

SignalEvent.title: SignalEvent

SignalFeedback.description: The student may confirm or dismiss a possible missed-content window.
SignalFeedback.title: SignalFeedback

SimulatedZoomBatch.description: At most 100 synthetic packets; raw media fields are forbidden.
SimulatedZoomBatch.title: SimulatedZoomBatch

SimulatedZoomChunk.description: Synthetic derived-text packet; epoch timestamps are integer milliseconds.
SimulatedZoomChunk.title: SimulatedZoomChunk

TimelinePage.description: Final transcript and the caller's private signals within a bounded interval.
TimelinePage.title: TimelinePage

TranscriptBatch.description: A bounded batch of independently revisioned transcript chunks.
TranscriptBatch.title: TranscriptBatch

TranscriptChunk.description: Selected derived text; revision increases for corrections or finalization.
TranscriptChunk.title: TranscriptChunk

HTTPBearer.description: Host-issued bearer token; session membership and consent are checked on every request.

info.description: Synthetic identities and providers. Only features installed in this checkout are registered.

post.description: Bearer membership and signal consent required. Atomic, retry-safe batch. Rejects raw media and caller identity; malformed payloads return 422, out-of-session ranges 400, conflicts 409. Optional local phone_visible observations support private recovery only with sustained corroboration; they never indicate attention or comprehension.
